adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, the sync branch always does `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, { method: "POST", body: new URLSearchParams({ calcomUserId, appSlug }) })` and returns the raw `Response`. This is not normalized to match the various return shapes expected by callers. Multiple updated call sites assume provider-specific response types/fields that a `fetch` Response does not have (e.g. GoogleCalendarService expects `res.data` after `myGoogleAuth.refreshToken(...).res`; Hubspot expects a `HubspotToken` object; Zoho Bigin expects `tokenInfo.data`). Under the sync branch these will receive a `Response` without `.data`, causing broken token refresh behavior. The finding’s point about missing normalization in the helper is directly supported by the diff and leads to incorrect runtime behavior.
